errors.text: The precipitate intervention is not operationally specified: precipitate chemistry, loading, size distribution, introduction route, and heat treatment are all absent.
The stated conditions are testing temperatures rather than processing boundaries, so the proposed microstructure cannot be reproduced.
Preservation of plasticity and machinability is asserted but neither mechanistically supported nor included in the falsification measurements.
The cited evidence does not directly demonstrate nanoprecipitate strengthening in CoCrFeNiTi; E1 does not support the proposed intervention, and E2 concerns a substantially different alloy system.
